map.：评估生精功能的关键，显著升高提示生精小管损伤、不可逆生精障碍: : a key indicator for assessing spermatogenesis; markedly elevated suggests seminiferous tubule damage and irreversible spermatogenic disorder
map.：T↓伴 LH↑ 提示 Leydig 细胞功能衰竭；T↓伴 LH↓ 提示垂体性: : T decreased with LH increased suggests Leydig cell failure; T decreased with LH decreased suggests pituitary origin
map.：高泌乳素血症抑制 GnRH，导致性腺功能减退: : hyperprolactinemia inhibits GnRH, leading to hypogonadism
map.：雌激素增多抑制 FSH/LH，可见于肥胖、肝病、芳香化酶活性升高: : increased estrogen inhibits FSH / LH, seen in obesity, liver disease and elevated aromatase activity
map.提示：参考范围因实验室方法不同存在差异，请以本室参考值为准。采血建议晨起空腹，避: Tip: reference ranges vary by laboratory method; please use your local laboratory reference values. Blood collection is recommended fasting in the morning, avoiding strenuous exercise.

map.FSH 升高伴 E2 不低 → 卵巢储备减退（DOR）倾向，建议 AMH 与 A: FSH elevated with E2 not low: tendency toward diminished ovarian reserve (DOR); recommend AMH and AFC recheck.

map.卵泡期 FSH>10 提示储备下降、>20 明显减退、>25 反应极差。: Follicular phase FSH>10 suggests declining reserve, >20 marked decline, >25 very poor response.
map.PCOS 常 LH/FSH≥2 伴 T 升高；需结合超声。: PCOS often has LH/FSH>=2 with elevated T; combine with ultrasound.
